references.text: The Gibeonites prepared their deception with old bread and worn-out sacks, which they later refer to in verse 12
The Gibeonites claimed to have come from a distant land, explaining why they said their bread had become dry
The Mosaic law regarding offering peace to distant cities, which the Gibeonites exploited by pretending to travel from far away
The Israelites tasted their traveling food without consulting the Lord and were deceived by what appeared to be old bread
